label: One individual at one world…, from The SAME supplied analyst classifier marks… and 3 more
description: From SAME known-limiting Q, nonlimiting Phi, backward closure and explicit EM, derive an accessible individual with Phi and not Q. If no such witness existed, EM on Q at each Phi-exemplar would give boxed universal Phi-to-Q inclusion, so closure would classify Phi limiting, contradicting nonlimitation. Typed reuse of the existing property/classifier vocabulary; a new direct stronger proof rather than an invalid projection from the old weaker possible-exemplification result. No frame law, source interpretation or necessity is added.
